text_block_list.text: Shortly before the Arima Kinen—

While rushing around the academy to scout 
out the other runners in the Arima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Dammit! —That made no sense at all. Back 
to recalculating...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Kris S is gonna exceed all predictions in 
this Arima Kinen, too. I've gotta 
anticipate that beforehand, or else—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—If I want to beat Kris S-san, doing 
things the way I did in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) definitely won't cut it...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I will surpass my limits even further...! 
To live up to everyone's expectations!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Fufu, looking good.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“Still, we have to stay sharp and push 
even further— Because Kris at the 'Arima 
Kinen' will be even stronger than she is 
now...!”

...It was clear from training that every 
single runner was intensely conscious of 
Symboli Kris S.

The Arima Kinen would be even harsher than 
anticipated. With that conviction in mind, 
time ticked away—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
――Nakayama Racecourse is already engulfed 
in roaring cheers! We are now drawing ever 
closer to the start of the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
We've got an insanely gorgeous lineup this 
year too~! Though the one to watch has 
gotta be Fine Motion! She's gonna pull it 
off today too~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No, if we're talking about that, wouldn't 
it be Symboli Kris S, who won the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn)? She really is crazy strong, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...A do-or-die gamble. I'll see it 
through to the end, Kris S."

—Right before the race, Symboli Kris S was 
in a state of absolute "business as 
usual."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—This is the final check. Are there—any 
points of concern?
choice_data_list:
...In today's race, all eyes will be on 
you.

...In today's race, all eyes will be on 
you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Focus……?

The lineup this time is stacked, featuring 
last year's Derby Umamusume and veteran 
runners who have been racing for a long 
time. Among them—

Fine Motion is also here—she belongs to 
the same class as Symboli Kris S and made 
a remarkable impact on this year's Tiara 
route.

Coincidentally, just like Symboli Kris S, 
she put up a strong performance in the 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup as a Classic-class 
runner alongside Senior-class rivals—

She is an Umamusume drawing heavy media 
attention as the top contender for this 
Arima Kinen.
And furthermore—

This time, there's also Tap Dance City—an 
unpredictable, completely mysterious 
presence.

"With so many threatening Umamusume out 
there, the most important fact we must 
keep in mind is—"
choice_data_list: Every Umamusume is on guard against you.
Every Umamusume is on guard against you.

text_block_list.text:
Everyone views Symboli Kris S as a threat, 
and they've gathered here at the Arima 
Kinen fired up to counter him.

It just goes to show how immense an impact 
Symboli Kris S's dazzling victory in the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn) had.
choice_data_list:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn) was just the first 
stone cast.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. If that's the case...—that's 
all the more reason—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
In today's race too, I will— with all my 
might... defeat everyone—equally.

Symboli Kris S shows not a shred of 
anxiety. Her "usual" demeanor appears 
endlessly dependable—
choice_data_list: Let's do what must be done.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yeah. —I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I leave it in your hands.
(WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —I've been waiting for you, Kris!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Fine.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I was really looking forward to running 
with you and everyone else today. —Let's 
make this the best memory ever!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Memories... memory...—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: …………Sorry. Fine... I can't do that.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I have already decided.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I will... fulfill my mission— stand at 
the pinnacle—and overwrite—every memory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of stopping—I will 
definitely fulfill it— So—the memories... 
that you desire—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I cannot... hand this over to you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Eyes like a frozen sky. Crystal clear 
without a cloud, and yet... so cold, so 
severe.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Kris—you have a mission that's yours 
alone, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that sounds wonderful. Now I just 
want to find out for myself!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Will you show me, I wonder? ...Through 
your running.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —That was my intention from the start.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
“—The stars of the day side-by-side having 
a chat! Well, don't you two look like 
you're having fun!”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Tap--

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...Her aura is different from last time. 
Just as Trainer said, I need to stay on 
guard—)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—However, I'm taking it for myself. That 
spotlight where you guys are standing!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"And so, I shall make my name known far 
and wide! All for the sake of 'romance'!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now— Are you ready to dance for me as I 
take center stage!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, this is quite a wonderful invitation 
as well...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
No matter who it is— I will accept the 
challenge—and win.
